summary: 5-day instructional design course covering ADDIE, blended learning, xAPI, Articulate Storyline, and Kirkpatrick evaluation. Build real course artefacts. Enroll
lede: Instructional design turns learning needs into structured online and blended experiences with clear objectives and aligned assessments. For learning and development professionals who design, develop, or manage these programs, the course covers training needs analysis, content sequencing based on cognitive load, modality selection, and assessment design that measures performance transfer rather than recall.
audienceIntro: This course is built for mid-career learning and development professionals who are responsible for designing, developing, or managing online and blended learning programs and need a structured, framework-driven approach to improve learning effectiveness.
modules: Training Needs Analysis and Learner Profiling
Learning Objectives and Course Blueprint Design
Blended Learning Design and Modality Selection
LMS Configuration, SCORM, xAPI, and Learning Data
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, you should meet the following requirements: Experience: Minimum 12 months in an L&D, training, instructional design, or curriculum development role; LMS familiarity: Working knowledge of at least one LMS platform (Moodle, Cornerstone, SAP SuccessFactors Learning, or equivalent); Technical setup: A laptop with Articulate Storyline 360 or Adobe Captivate trial version installed prior to Day 1 (free trials available from vendor websites); No coding required: All authoring tool exercises use visual/GUI-based interfaces; no HTML, CSS, or JavaScript knowledge is needed; Preparation: Participants are encouraged to bring a real performance gap or training challenge from their organization to use as the basis for workshop exercises throughout the course
